Eve - Album 1: WHO

The Eve of Things to Come

"It's the eve of things to come"

[Intro]

Morning light Cheap alarm Cold floor waiting Same old charm

Another day Another run Nothing strange Nothing begun

[Verse 1]

I wake before the city really starts Stretch out the stiffness, steady my heart A little exercise beside the bed Trying to wake the rest of my head

My fingers find the necklace at my chest Old little habit I never second-guess Grandma said it came from parents I never knew So I keep it close because that’s what I do

Coffee in the kitchen Questionable at best Burnt around the edges But it passes every test

I can’t afford the fancy kind Student budgets make you kind

To terrible coffee

Eventually

[Pre-Chorus]

Scholarship covers the classes Not the rest of my life Phone bill waiting Groceries tight

So I work the library Shelving stories every night

I could ask Grandma But I want to get this right

On my own

[Chorus]

It’s the eve of things to come Though I don’t know anything is coming Just another ordinary morning Just another day already running

I know my books I know my route I know what every month takes out

Coffee Classes Work when I’m done

Nothing different underneath the sun

It’s the eve of things to come

And I don’t know it yet

[Verse 2]

Eggs in the pan and yesterday’s bread Notes from a lecture spread by my bed Mythology, folklore, legends and lies Every old monster that refuses to die

I don’t know why they pull me in Every curse, every claw, every tale of skin Vampires, witches, creatures unnamed Different cultures, different rules, never quite the same

People call them stories Warnings dressed in ink I keep finding reasons To look a little deeper than they think

Maybe it’s curiosity Maybe I’m just strange

Either way I like the chase

[Pre-Chorus]

Shower running Backpack packed Notebook ready Pens intact

Library shift later If my schedule doesn’t crack

But first there’s class And today’s the one I’ve waited for

[Chorus]

It’s the eve of things to come Though I don’t know anything is coming Just another ordinary morning Just another day already running

I know my books I know my route I know what every month takes out

Coffee Classes Work when I’m done

Nothing different underneath the sun

It’s the eve of things to come

And I don’t know it yet

[Bridge]

Today’s about vampires

Finally

The old traditions The history The weaknesses The blood

Sunlight Mirrors Garlic Faith

Everything the stories say

I already know half the lecture But I still want every page

Because somewhere in the details There’s always something strange

And maybe that’s what keeps me listening

Maybe that’s why I came

[Final Chorus]

It’s the eve of things to come And the morning feels completely normal Same old hallway Same old books Same old world behaving formal

I know my plans I know my day I know exactly what comes next

Class at nine Library late Dinner if I don’t forget

It’s the eve of things to come

Nothing’s changed

Nothing yet

[Outro]

My phone begins to ring

I glance down at the screen

An unfamiliar number

I almost let it be

But something makes me answer

Hello?

And everything changes.
